related.title: NGINX 反向代理：真實來源與標頭信任界線
related.titleEn: NGINX reverse proxy: source identity and header trust
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：96%與99%不混作郵件投遞率或內容安全率；每個MX都驗證名稱、鏈與政策。 交付MX政策矩陣、兩組報告計算與逐失敗類型修正紀錄。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Do not label 96% or 99% as mail delivery or content-safety rates; verify name, chain and policy for every MX. Deliver MX policy tests, two report calculations and remediation records by failure type.
related.difference: 畫出客戶、邊緣代理、內部代理與應用四段；將socket peer、X-Forwarded-For與應用採用來源分欄，逐跳標示誰有權新增資料。
related.differenceEn: Map client, edge proxy, internal proxy and app; separate socket peer, X-Forwarded-For and adopted source, marking which hop can append trusted data.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 傳輸成功率=成功的報告sessions/報告總sessions；報告涵蓋率需另外追蹤，缺報告不代表成功。 教學日報1000個sessions，其中40失敗；此樣本僅含有回報的寄送端。 (1000−40)/1000×100=96%；同樣1000筆中只剩10失敗時為99%。
來源追溯覆蓋率=同時具有可信代理鏈與關聯ID的請求/全部測試請求；偽造標頭不能因語法有效就受信任。 合成200筆請求中，160筆具有完整可信鏈與關聯ID，40筆缺一項。 160/200×100=80%；補齊30筆後190/200×100=95%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Transport success rate equals successful reported sessions divided by reported sessions; track reporting coverage separately because missing reports do not prove success. A teaching daily report contains 1000 sessions with 40 failures, covering only reporting senders. (1000−40)/1000×100=96%; with 10 failures among the same 1000 sessions, success is 99%.

Source-lineage coverage is requests with both trusted proxy chain and correlation ID divided by all test requests; syntactically valid headers are not inherently trusted. Of 200 synthetic requests, 160 have complete trusted lineage and correlation IDs, while 40 miss one requirement. 160/200×100=80%; repairing 30 yields 190/200×100=95%.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: OCSF：跨產品事件語義與版本契約
related.titleEn: OCSF: cross-product event semantics and version contracts
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：96%與99%不混作郵件投遞率或內容安全率；每個MX都驗證名稱、鏈與政策。 交付MX政策矩陣、兩組報告計算與逐失敗類型修正紀錄。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Do not label 96% or 99% as mail delivery or content-safety rates; verify name, chain and policy for every MX. Deliver MX policy tests, two report calculations and remediation records by failure type.
related.difference: 選認證事件，將三個虛構產品的user、status、時間與來源映射到一份鎖定版本的schema；保留原始列與無法映射的欄位。
related.differenceEn: Map authentication user, status, time and source from three fictional products into a pinned schema version; retain raw rows and unmapped fields.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 傳輸成功率=成功的報告sessions/報告總sessions；報告涵蓋率需另外追蹤，缺報告不代表成功。 教學日報1000個sessions，其中40失敗；此樣本僅含有回報的寄送端。 (1000−40)/1000×100=96%；同樣1000筆中只剩10失敗時為99%。
語義完整率=所有必填且可解釋欄位通過的事件/總事件；JSON語法有效與schema有效、語義正確是三層不同判定。 合成240事件中，204筆通過必填欄位、型別與狀態語義驗證，36筆隔離。 204/240×100=85%；修正24筆後228/240×100=95%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Transport success rate equals successful reported sessions divided by reported sessions; track reporting coverage separately because missing reports do not prove success. A teaching daily report contains 1000 sessions with 40 failures, covering only reporting senders. (1000−40)/1000×100=96%; with 10 failures among the same 1000 sessions, success is 99%.

Semantic completeness is events with all required interpretable fields divided by total events; valid JSON, valid schema and correct meaning are distinct checks. Of 240 synthetic events, 204 pass required-field, type and status-semantics checks, with 36 quarantined. 204/240×100=85%; correcting 24 yields 228/240×100=95%.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
